name: Ollama + Open WebUI
summary: Private ChatGPT-style chat on CPU with Ollama and Open WebUI, a small model pre-loaded and sign-up closed.
notes: Ollama 0.40.11 and Open WebUI v0.12.3 pinned by tag and digest, CPU only. The qwen2.5:0.5b model (Apache-2.0) is pulled at first run; larger models can be pulled from the UI and need more RAM. The admin account is created from environment variables at first start and sign-up is disabled, so there is no first-visitor window. The Ollama API listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Open WebUI branding is left untouched as its licence requires. Without a domain the site is served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate for the IP address.

licence.note: Open WebUI: BSD-3-Clause text plus a branding clause (not pure BSD, not OSI approved). Ollama MIT. Model qwen2.5:0.5b Apache-2.0. Caddy (Apache-2.0) is installed on the host as the reverse proxy.
conditions: Open WebUI clause 4: the name, logo and visual or textual identifiers of Open WebUI must not be altered, removed, obscured or replaced in any deployment
The clause is waived only for deployments of 50 end users or fewer in any rolling 30 days, with written permission from Open WebUI Inc., or with an enterprise licence
This recipe never sets WEBUI_NAME or custom logos; customers must not rebrand the UI without a licence
Keep the BSD-3-Clause copyright notice and disclaimer; the licence forbids using the contributors names to endorse products
Models pulled later carry their own licences (the preloaded qwen2.5:0.5b is Apache-2.0)
